title: Pork Pot Stickers
description: A classic Chinese dish filled with tender pork and wrapped in crispy pot sticker wrappers. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped scallions and grated ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the ground pork and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 3-4 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper to taste.
Lay out the pot sticker wrappers on a clean surface.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Moisten the edges of the wrapper with water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the pot stickers and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
